items.name: ApprovalRequest
items.summary: The customer's decision on one exact revision. Approval needs a typed name and explicit consent, and is refused for stale revisions. Recording the result is the app's job (pair with ApprovalSnapshot).

props.name: amount
props.doc: The amount being approved, and whether it includes tax (the customer must know which).

props.name: staleReason
props.doc: When set, the revision changed after it was sent and can't be approved.

props.name: consentText
props.doc: The app's approved legal wording, in the customer's language.

props.name: errorMessage
props.doc: Shown above the actions when approving or sending fails; what was typed is kept.

props.name: onApprove
props.type: ((decision: { signerName: string; acceptedAt: string; }) => void) | undefined

items.name: ChecklistTemplate
items.summary: A firm's reusable checklist or work package, versioned and owned (F-C16, F-C01).

props.name: visibility
props.doc: Firm-private by default (principle 11).

items.name: CommentThread
items.summary: A question or discussion with an owner, a due date, and a clear private/shared boundary on every message.

props.name: title
props.doc: e.g. "RFI-012 · Cabinet depth at window wall".

props.name: links
props.doc: Linked sources, scope items, or drawings.

props.name: onPost
props.doc: Return a promise; the text is kept if posting fails.

props.name: canShare
props.doc: Whether the customer can be included; when false every post is private.

items.name: NotificationList
items.summary: The inbox list: unread first, each item says what happened, where, and when.

props.name: settings
props.doc: Link or button to notification preferences (digest, mute, channels).

items.name: NotificationsPopover
items.summary: A bell button with the unread count that opens the notification list (F-S14).

props.name: settings
props.doc: Link or button to notification preferences (digest, mute, channels).

items.name: TaskList
items.summary: Tasks with owners, due dates, locations, and blockers; overdue and blocked are stated in words, not only colour.

props.name: collapseDone
props.doc: Hide completed tasks behind a count.

items.name: TaskProgress
items.summary: What the assistant is doing, step by step, with recoverable failures and nothing applied silently.

props.name: onRetry
props.doc: Retry from a failed step; completed steps are not repeated.

props.name: result
props.doc: Shown when every step is done: what was produced and where it went (always a draft).

items.name: CommandMenu
items.summary: Permission-aware search across documents, scope, decisions and assets; also a ⌘K command palette.

props.name: hiddenCount
props.doc: Results the viewer can't open under their permissions; counted, never shown.

props.name: isOpen
props.doc: Open with ⌘K / Ctrl+K.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.doc: Visible trigger label; also the trigger's name on narrow screens.

items.name: ErrorSummary
items.summary: Lists every problem after a failed submit, takes focus, and each item moves focus to its field (GOV.UK pattern).

items.name: ImportMapper
items.summary: Map a spreadsheet's columns to Framed fields, see sample values, unit conversions, and row problems, then import.

props.name: columns
props.type: { id: string; header: string; sample: string[]; }[]

props.name: mapping
props.doc: column id → target id ("" = skip).

props.name: sourceUnits
props.doc: column id → the unit the file uses for that column.

props.name: fileCurrency
props.doc: Currency of amounts in the file; a mismatch with the workspace currency blocks the import.

props.name: rowIssues
props.type: { row: number; target: string; message: string; }[] | undefined

items.name: Lightbox
items.summary: Full-screen photo viewer with previous/next (also ←/→); returns focus on close.

items.name: MediaGrid
items.summary: Photo grid with arrow-key navigation; opening a photo shows a lightbox that returns focus to it on close. With selection on, each photo has a checkbox (selection is never shown by colour alone).

props.name: emptyState
props.doc: Shown when there are no photos, e.g. with an action to add some.

items.name: MediaImage
items.summary: An image that shows its description in a neutral tile if it fails to load.

items.name: SourceViewer
items.summary: Shows exactly where a fact came from: the page, with the fact highlighted. Page with the buttons or PageUp/PageDown (←/→ at fit). Zoom with the buttons or +/−/0; when zoomed, drag or use the arrow keys to pan.

props.name: pages
props.doc: One image URL per page (rendered PDF pages, drawings, or photos).

items.name: DraftSuggestion
items.summary: AI output stays an editable draft until a person accepts it (principle 9).

props.name: suggestion
props.doc: When this changes (e.g. after regenerating), the editable text resets to it.

props.name: status
props.doc: Controlled status; omit to let the component track it.

props.name: onRegenerate
props.doc: Ask the assistant for another version (F-S10).

props.name: onUndo
props.doc: Reverse an accept or dismiss.

items.name: LifecycleTag
items.summary: Distinguishes the current record from proposed, approved, and completed work by shape, not only colour.

items.name: MoneyRange
items.summary: An indicative budget: a low–high range, its biggest drivers, and its basis. Never a quote (F-H26, F-H36).

props.name: low
props.doc: Either end can be unknown; an unknown end is never shown as 0.

props.name: drivers
props.doc: What moves the number, as shares of the range (0–1), largest first.

props.name: basis
props.doc: What the range is based on, e.g. "Supplied measurements · prices from Oct 2026".

items.name: Money
items.summary: Tabular, currency-explicit amount.

props.name: amount
props.doc: `null` renders as Unknown.

props.name: currency
props.doc: Defaults to the LocaleProvider currency.

items.name: Quantity
items.summary: A number with its unit; `null` is Unknown, never 0.

items.name: SourceTag
items.summary: Provenance for a fact: where it came from, when, and whether it is verified.

props.name: date
props.doc: Date or ISO string (preferred); free text is shown as given.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: A value that is not yet known. Never substitute zero or a guess (principle 7).

items.name: VisibilityTag
items.summary: Marks whether content is contractor-private or shared with the customer (principle 11).

items.name: lineAmount
items.summary: Amount for a line: quantity (plus waste) × rate, in whole cents; `null` when either is unknown.

items.name: LineItemGrid
items.summary: Spreadsheet-style editing with WAI-ARIA grid keyboard support: arrows move, Enter or F2 edits, Enter commits and moves down, Esc cancels, Tab commits and leaves the cell. Unknown quantities and rates stay unknown.

props.name: units
props.doc: Units offered in the unit cell, e.g. ["lot", "hr", "m²", "lin m", "ea"].

props.name: groupBy
props.doc: Group rows (room or trade) with a subtotal per group.

props.name: rates
props.doc: The firm's rate library. When given, editing a rate offers library rates (typing a number still works).

items.name: ApprovalSnapshot
items.summary: The exact thing someone approved, frozen. Flags when later edits make it stale.

props.name: date
props.doc: Date or ISO string.

props.name: affectedBy
props.doc: Later changes that affect what was approved.

items.name: AssistantMessage
items.summary: Conversation turn. Assistant answers cite sources and never apply changes on their own.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Actions on an assistant suggestion, e.g. "Apply to draft".

items.name: AssistantThread
items.summary: The assistant conversation: a live log with context, pending, and error states.

props.name: context
props.type: { project: string; sourceCount: number; hiddenCount?: number | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: What the assistant can see under the viewer's permissions.

items.name: ChangePreview
items.summary: Exactly what an AI edit or import will change, before it is applied.

props.name: changes
props.type: { label: string; before: ReactNode; after: ReactNode; }[]

items.name: Composer
items.summary: The message box for asking the assistant: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, Stop while answering.

props.name: onSubmit
props.doc: Return a promise to keep the text until it resolves; on rejection the text stays for another try.

props.name: isPending
props.doc: While the assistant is answering: send becomes Stop.

props.name: submitOnEnter
props.doc: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. ⌘/Ctrl+Enter always sends.

items.name: ContactRow
items.summary: A project contact with role and what they can access.

items.name: customerBreakdown
items.summary: The customer's rows: private lines are removed and their total folded into fixed lines proportionally; allowances, provisional sums, contingency, and credits keep their face value. Returns problems instead of a misleading result. Exported so apps can produce the same figures for PDFs and emails.

items.name: EstimateBreakdown
items.summary: Totals with visible arithmetic. The customer view never shows private lines or the working (`customerBreakdown`).

props.name: total
props.doc: Total before tax.

props.name: taxes
props.doc: Configured taxes; when present a tax-inclusive grand total is shown (F-C25, F-S19).

props.name: partial
props.doc: Also mark the total partial; unpriced in-price lines are detected automatically.

items.name: FileDrop
items.summary: Drop or choose plans, photos, notes, and quotes. Originals are kept as sources. Type and size are checked here; servers must check again, since a file's name and type are supplied by the browser.

props.name: accept
props.doc: MIME types or extensions, e.g. ["application/pdf", "image/*", ".xlsx"]. Enforced for drops and the picker.

props.name: maxSize
props.doc: Bytes.

items.name: FileItem
items.summary: One file with its status (saved locally, uploading, reading, ready, needs review, failed) and actions.

props.name: error
props.doc: Why it failed, in plain words.

items.name: ItemKind
items.summary: Keeps allowances, provisional sums, contingency, and exclusions visibly distinct from fixed amounts.

items.name: lineItemKinds
items.summary: Every line item kind, in display order.

items.name: OpenItems
items.summary: What must be resolved before pricing or work can continue, each with a concrete next step and an owner.

items.name: OptionCompare
items.summary: Side-by-side alternatives with shared scope; rows that differ are marked.

items.name: Provenance
items.summary: How a fact is known. Pair with `SourceTag` for where it came from.

items.name: QuestionCard
items.summary: A targeted clarification. Answers link back to the brief and scope items they affect (F-C11).

props.name: to
props.doc: Full name for the header; `recipientName` (short) is used on the send button.

props.name: onRecordAnswer
props.doc: Record an answer received outside Framed (phone, site visit). Return a promise to keep the text if saving fails.

props.name: inList
props.doc: In lists, the send action is secondary so each region keeps one primary.

items.name: ScopeSection
items.summary: A room or trade package with inclusions, exclusions, assumptions, and open questions (read view; edit with ScopeItemEditor).

items.name: settled
items.summary: Awaits a result or invokes a callback; use a callback to catch synchronous throws as well as rejections.

items.name: SharePreview
items.summary: Exactly what a recipient will receive, and what stays private, before an external action.

items.name: SpaceTree
items.summary: Property → floors → rooms → assets, with keyboard navigation and partial coverage.

items.name: useItemKindLabel
items.summary: Localized name of a line item kind, e.g. for a select.

items.name: ProviderCard
items.summary: A contractor or professional in search results or a shortlist. Claims are evidence with dates, never "trusted".

props.name: summary
props.doc: e.g. "General contractor · Halifax".

props.name: rating
props.type: { value: number | null; count: number; } | undefined
props.doc: Only ratings from verified jobs; `null` when there are none (never shown as 0).

props.name: verified
props.type: { label: string; checkedOn: string | Date; }[] | undefined
props.doc: Credentials Framed has checked, with the date checked (F-M28: evidence, not guarantees).

props.name: sponsored
props.doc: Paid placement is always labelled and kept apart from relevance (F-M28).

props.name: matchReason
props.doc: Why this provider is shown (F-M06: explainable matching).

props.name: headingLevel
props.doc: Heading level of the name; match the page outline (2 under the page title, 3 inside a titled section).

items.name: ReviewCard
items.summary: A review tied to a verified job, with the firm's response.

props.name: job
props.doc: What the review is tied to, e.g. "Kitchen renovation, 2026". Only verified-interaction reviews are shown (F-M27).

props.name: response
props.type: { by: string; body: ReactNode; at: string | Date; } | undefined

items.name: FloorPlan
items.summary: A 2D plan of one level. Each room is a button on the drawing and also a row in the list beside it, so everything on the plan is reachable by keyboard and screen reader (F-H46). Unmeasured areas show as Unknown. For 3D or scan viewers, render them in the app and keep this list as their accessible equivalent.

props.name: pins
props.doc: Assets, issues, or notes pinned to a location (F-H19).

props.name: unit
props.doc: Plan unit for lengths, e.g. "m"; areas use its square.

props.name: levels
props.doc: Several floors: shown as a level switcher above the plan. Pass the current level's rooms and pins.

props.name: emptyState
props.doc: Shown when the level has no mapped rooms yet (e.g. an action to import or draw a plan).

items.name: ImageCompare
items.summary: Two photos of the same view, compared with a slider (arrow keys move it). Both images keep their own alt text.

props.name: before
props.type: { src: string; alt: string; label?: string | undefined; }

props.name: after
props.type: { src: string; alt: string; label?: string | undefined; }

props.name: defaultPosition
props.doc: 0–1: where the divider starts, from the start edge (0.5 = middle). The "after" image shows past it.

items.name: TakeoffCanvas
items.summary: Measure lengths, areas, and counts on a scale-confirmed drawing (F-C19). Click to add points; double-click or "Finish" completes the shape. Every measurement is listed with its value, and values can be typed instead of drawn, so the takeoff works without a pointer. Without a confirmed scale, lengths and areas stay Unknown.

props.name: src
props.doc: The page or drawing image.

props.name: pageWidth
props.doc: Real length of the page's full width, from a confirmed scale (e.g. 12.4 for 12.4 m). Null = not calibrated.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.doc: Page height divided by width, so area maths uses the true proportions.

props.name: onScaleChange
props.doc: Calibrate from the drawing: the person draws along a dimension they know and types its real length; this receives the resulting page width. Without it, the scale must be supplied by the app.

items.name: takeoffValue
items.summary: Compute a measurement's value in real units; null when the scale isn't known.

items.name: VoiceNote
items.summary: Record or play a site voice note. Consent is confirmed first; the transcript is a draft until reviewed.

props.name: src
props.doc: A saved recording to play back.

props.name: transcript
props.doc: The transcript; shown as an AI draft until `transcriptReviewed`.

props.name: onRecord
props.doc: Called with the finished recording. Recording only starts after the person confirms consent.

props.name: consentText
props.doc: Wording of the consent the app requires, e.g. that everyone present agreed to be recorded.

items.name: BidLeveling
items.summary: Compare trade or supplier bids against the same scope: gaps, exclusions, and allowances are visible before choosing.

props.name: bids
props.type: { id: string; name: string; total: number | null; expires?: string | Date | undefined; }[]

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; coverage: Record<string, Coverage>; note?: Record<string, string> | undefined; }[]
props.doc: Scope items down the side; `coverage[bidId]` says how each bid treats it.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Never chosen automatically; a person selects (F-M18).

items.name: Board
items.summary: Leads or requests in stages (new → qualifying → bidding → won/lost). Drag between columns, or use "Move to".

props.name: onMove
props.doc: Move a card to another column. Every card also has a "Move to" menu, so moving never needs dragging.

props.name: headingLevel
props.doc: Heading level of the column titles, to match the page outline.

items.name: BudgetVariance
items.summary: Budget, committed, and actual by cost code; variance is computed only where both sides are known.

items.name: EventCalendar
items.summary: Care tasks, inspections, deliveries, and visits by day. The month view is a table of days; the agenda view lists the same events in order and is the better choice on phones and for screen readers.

props.name: month
props.doc: Any day in the month to show (ISO date).

props.name: headingLevel
props.doc: Heading level of the month name, to match the page outline.

items.name: ProposalStatusBadge
items.summary: Where a proposal stands with the customer; draft is dashed, ended states are outlined.

items.name: Schedule
items.summary: A simple Gantt view: one row per item with its dates in text, so the schedule is readable without the bars. Read-only; editing dates happens in the item's form (F-C43 requires previewing impact before notifying).

props.name: from
props.doc: Defaults to the earliest start and latest end.

props.name: today
props.doc: A date marked on the timeline, usually today.

items.name: SelectionCard
items.summary: One product decision against its allowance and deadline.

props.name: item
props.doc: What is being chosen, e.g. "Kitchen faucet".

props.name: choice
props.type: { name: string; spec?: string | undefined; image?: string | undefined; price: number | null; } | null
props.doc: The chosen product, or null while undecided.

props.name: allowance
props.doc: Allowance for this selection; overage is shown, never hidden in the total.

props.name: neededBy
props.doc: Needed-by date for the decision.

items.name: SyncStatus
items.summary: Whether field changes have reached everyone; conflicts must be resolved before publishing.

props.name: pending
props.doc: Changes saved on this device but not yet sent.

items.name: Timesheet
items.summary: Crew time by person and day, with cost code and labour cost (F-C54). Hours not entered stay blank, totals say "partial" when anything is missing, and approved entries can't be edited.

props.name: costCodes
props.doc: Cost codes offered for each entry.

items.name: allocateMilestones
items.summary: Allocates milestone amounts in whole cents; the last milestone takes the rounding remainder.

items.name: InvoiceDocument
items.summary: An invoice for agreed work: what it bills, tax, what's been paid, and what's still due.

props.name: letterhead
props.doc: The firm's letterhead: logo, address, licence or registration number (F-C29). Colours stay Plumb's.

props.name: payments
props.type: { id: string; label: string; amount: number; on: string | Date; }[] | undefined
props.doc: Payments already received against this invoice.

props.name: footer
props.doc: Payment instructions or a pay button.

props.name: headingLevel
props.doc: Heading level of the title: 1 when the invoice is the page, 2 inside a workspace page.

items.name: PaymentSchedule
items.summary: Deposit and progress payments. Shares must add to 100 % of the total, and the sum is always shown.

props.name: partial
props.doc: The total is partial (unpriced items): payments are shares of an incomplete price.

props.name: createId
props.doc: Creates ids for new milestones; defaults to `crypto.randomUUID()`.

items.name: proposalBlockers
items.summary: Every reason a proposal can't be issued, including computed checks. Language-neutral; see `useProposalBlockers`.

items.name: ProposalDocument
items.summary: The customer-facing proposal. It always marks non-fixed lines and partial totals, and lists issue blockers.

props.name: letterhead
props.doc: The firm's letterhead: logo, address, licence or registration number (F-C29). Colours stay Plumb's.

props.name: total
props.doc: Total before tax; must equal the sum of priced lines.

props.name: taxes
props.doc: Configured taxes; the customer then sees and approves a tax-inclusive total.

props.name: partial
props.doc: Unpriced or excluded items exist; the total says "partial".

props.name: issueBlockers
props.doc: Reasons the proposal can't be issued yet, in the reader's language. Combined with computed ones.

props.name: headingLevel
props.doc: Heading level of the title: 1 when the proposal is the page (customer view), 2 inside a workspace page.

items.name: proposalTotals
items.summary: Totals every proposal view shares: the price excludes options and exclusions; the schedule is checked against the tax-inclusive total the customer approves.

items.name: scheduleGap
items.summary: Amount of the total not covered by the schedule (negative when it's over).

items.name: useProposalBlockers
items.summary: `proposalBlockers` as sentences in the current locale; use them to disable Issue with a reason.

items.name: AccessManager
items.summary: Who can see this project or home, in which role, and until when; with invite and revoke (F-S03, F-C38, F-H35, F-M10).

props.name: roles
props.type: { id: string; label: string; description?: string | undefined; }[]

props.name: defaultInviteRole
props.doc: Least-privilege role preselected for invites (never the owner role).

props.name: assignableRoles
props.doc: Roles the current user may grant; defaults to all except the first (owner).

props.name: onInvite
props.type: ((invite: { email: string; role: string; expiresAt?: string | undefined; }) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: Return a promise: the typed email is kept if the invite fails.

props.name: onRevoke
props.doc: Return a promise: the confirmation stays open until it resolves and shows the error if it rejects.

props.name: lockedIds
props.doc: Who can't be changed (e.g. the owner, or yourself).

items.name: FactField
items.summary: A single fact: its value, how it's known, where it came from, and every correction.

props.name: history
props.doc: Earlier values, newest first. The original evidence is never overwritten (F-H10).

props.name: onChange
props.type: ((value: string | number | null, note: string) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: Save a correction with its reason. Return a promise to keep the form open (and the text) if saving fails.

items.name: lineChange
items.summary: How one line changed between revisions.

items.name: priceDelta
items.summary: The price effect of a set of line changes. Options and exclusions aren't in the price; an unpriced side makes the change partial, never a fake 0.

items.name: RevisionDiff
items.summary: What changed between two revisions, line by line, with the price effect (F-S06, F-C34, F-C80, F-M19).

props.name: affectsApprovals
props.doc: Approvals that the changes invalidate.

props.name: showUnchanged
props.doc: Show unchanged lines too.

items.name: RevisionPicker
items.summary: Choose which revision to view and which to compare against (F-S06).

props.name: baselineId
props.doc: The revision others are compared against (e.g. the approved baseline).

items.name: RatePicker
items.summary: Type to find a rate in the firm's library; shows unit, region, and date, and flags unit mismatches and stale rates.

props.name: forUnit
props.doc: The unit of the line being priced; a rate in another unit is flagged and never silently converted.

props.name: staleAfterDays
props.doc: Rates older than this many days are marked stale (F-C27).

props.name: currency
props.doc: Currency of the line being priced; rates in another currency are shown but can't be chosen. Defaults to the workspace currency.

props.name: allowsCustomValue
props.doc: For use inside an editable cell: typed text that isn't a library rate is kept (e.g. a number).

items.name: ScopeItemEditor
items.summary: Inclusions, exclusions, assumptions, and open questions for a room or trade package: add, edit, reorder (move buttons, or drag), change kind, accept drafts, and insert saved templates. Every item can carry its source.

props.name: templates
props.doc: Reviewed work packages and checklists that can be inserted (F-C16). Inserted items arrive as drafts.

props.name: createId
props.doc: Creates ids for new items; defaults to `crypto.randomUUID()`.

items.name: scopeItemKinds
items.summary: Every scope item kind, in display order.

items.name: AppShell
items.summary: Sidebar + top bar workspace frame for contractor screens. Below 960px the sidebar becomes a sheet opened from the top bar (F-S15). The first focusable element skips to the content (WCAG 2.4.1).

props.name: sidebarHead
props.doc: Replaces the product mark at the top of the sidebar, e.g. a `WorkspaceSwitcher`.

props.name: aside
props.doc: A persistent side panel, e.g. the assistant (F-S09). A column beside the content from 1200px; below that it opens as a sheet. Control it with `isAsideOpen` / `onAsideOpenChange` (a top-bar button usually toggles it).

items.name: Journey
items.summary: Where the project is in intake → estimate → proposal → record.

items.name: PageHeader
items.summary: The page's h1 with eyebrow, description, meta, and the page's primary action.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Sit on the title row, aligned to the h1.

props.name: actionHint
props.doc: Short reason under the actions, e.g. why the primary action is disabled.

items.name: PublicShell
items.summary: Frame for pages without the workspace sidebar: sign-in, the customer portal, shared proposals, public profiles.

props.name: brand
props.doc: Left of the header: the firm's or Framed's name and mark.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Right of the header: sign in, help, language.

props.name: width
props.doc: `narrow` (sign-in, approvals), `medium` (proposals, portal), `wide` (marketplace listings).

items.name: WorkspaceSwitcher
items.summary: Switch between firms, households, and homes without mixing their records (F-S02, F-H41).

props.name: actions
props.type: { id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; }[] | undefined
props.doc: Extra menu entries, e.g. "Add a home".

items.name: useLocale
items.summary: Returns the current locale and layout direction.

items.name: Button
items.summary: `isPending` keeps the button's width, shows a spinner, and blocks repeat presses (React Aria announces it).

props.name: variant
props.doc: One `primary` per task region. `soft` is a quiet brand-tinted alternative.

props.name: ref
props.doc: React 19 passes refs as props; this reaches the <button>.

items.name: IconButton
items.summary: A button with only an icon. `label` is required and becomes its accessible name.

props.name: label
props.doc: Required accessible name.

props.name: variant
props.doc: One `primary` per task region. `soft` is a quiet brand-tinted alternative.

props.name: ref
props.doc: React 19 passes refs as props; this reaches the <button>.

items.name: Link
items.summary: Inline text link; `quiet` inherits the text colour and keeps the underline.

items.name: Calendar
items.summary: A month you can pick a day from, shown inline (scheduling panels, availability).

items.name: CheckboxGroup
items.summary: Several independent choices under one label: notification channels, trades, document types.

props.name: options
props.type: { value: string; label: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; isDisabled?: boolean | undefined; }[]

props.name: orientation
props.doc: `row` lays short options side by side.

props.name: optional
props.doc: Marks the field optional in its label; required is the default expectation.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

props.name: labelAside
props.doc: Right side of the label row, e.g. a `<Provenance>` badge for the value.

items.name: DateRangePicker
items.summary: Start and end dates with a range calendar: schedules, access windows, reporting periods (F-C41, F-C43).

props.name: optional
props.doc: Marks the field optional in its label; required is the default expectation.

props.name: labelAside
props.doc: Right side of the label row, e.g. a `<Provenance>` badge for the value.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

items.name: FormattedTextField
items.summary: Multi-line text with bold, italic, and list buttons (Ctrl/⌘+B, Ctrl/⌘+I). Stores Markdown; render with FormattedText.

props.name: preview
props.doc: Show a live preview under the field.

props.name: optional
props.doc: Marks the field optional in its label; required is the default expectation.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

props.name: labelAside
props.doc: Right side of the label row, e.g. a `<Provenance>` badge for the value.

items.name: FormattedText
items.summary: Renders a small, safe Markdown subset (paragraphs, **bold**, *italic*, "- " lists, "1. " lists, [links](https://…)) as React elements: never HTML, so text from customers and the assistant can't inject markup. Links must be http(s) or mailto; anything else is shown as text.

items.name: MultiSelect
items.summary: Choose several from a list (trades, service areas, roles). Chosen items show as removable tags below.

props.name: name
props.doc: Submitted with the form as one value per selected key.

props.name: optional
props.doc: Marks the field optional in its label; required is the default expectation.

props.name: labelAside
props.doc: Right side of the label row, e.g. a `<Provenance>` badge for the value.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

items.name: OneTimeCodeField
items.summary: A one-time sign-in or confirmation code. One input (not one box per digit), so paste and autofill work.

props.name: length
props.doc: Number of characters; the field accepts digits only.

props.name: optional
props.doc: Marks the field optional in its label; required is the default expectation.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

props.name: labelAside
props.doc: Right side of the label row, e.g. a `<Provenance>` badge for the value.

items.name: PasswordField
items.summary: Password entry with a show/hide button. Paste and password managers always work (WCAG 3.3.8).

props.name: autoComplete
props.doc: `current-password` to sign in, `new-password` when creating one (lets password managers help).

props.name: optional
props.doc: Marks the field optional in its label; required is the default expectation.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

props.name: labelAside
props.doc: Right side of the label row, e.g. a `<Provenance>` badge for the value.

items.name: RangeCalendar
items.summary: An inline month for choosing a start and end day.

items.name: Rating
items.summary: Star rating with radio semantics; read-only ratings announce "4 of 5" as text (F-M27).

props.name: label
props.doc: Required: what is being rated, e.g. "Quality of work".

props.name: value
props.doc: 1–max. `null` = not rated (never shown as 0 stars).

props.name: isReadOnly
props.doc: Read-only display, e.g. on a review card.

items.name: RecurrenceField
items.summary: How often something repeats (care tasks, reminders): "every 3 months until 2027-06-30", or not at all.

items.name: Slider
items.summary: Choose a value or range on a scale: margin sensitivity, contingency share, budget ranges (F-C27, F-H26). Pass `formatOptions` (e.g. percent or currency) so the value reads correctly.

items.name: TimeField
items.summary: Locale-aware time entry: crew hours, visit windows, inspection bookings (F-C54, F-C61).

props.name: optional
props.doc: Marks the field optional in its label; required is the default expectation.

props.name: labelAside
props.doc: Right side of the label row, e.g. a `<Provenance>` badge for the value.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

items.name: ToggleButton
items.summary: A pressed/not-pressed control: "Show private lines", "Pin", view options.

props.name: aria-label
props.doc: Icon-only toggles need a name.

items.name: Toolbar
items.summary: Groups related actions; arrow keys move between them and Tab leaves the group (WAI-ARIA toolbar).

props.name: aria-label
props.doc: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

items.name: AvatarGroup
items.summary: A row of overlapping avatars, announced as one list of names.

items.name: Avatar
items.summary: Initials in a stable category colour; announced as the person's name.

props.name: color
props.doc: Defaults to a stable category colour derived from the name.

items.name: Badge
items.summary: Short status label. Always includes text; icons support, never replace, it.

props.name: variant
props.doc: `dashed` marks drafts and proposals; `outline` marks reviewed states.

items.name: Callout
items.summary: Inline guidance next to the work it affects. Prefer over toasts.

props.name: live
props.doc: Announce to screen readers when it appears (results of an action). Static guidance stays silent.

items.name: EmptyState
items.summary: What appears before there's anything to show: say what will be here and how to add it.

items.name: IconTile
items.summary: CategoryColor square that gives an icon a home.

items.name: Kbd
items.summary: A keyboard key or shortcut, e.g. <Kbd>⌘K</Kbd>.

items.name: Meter
items.summary: A known quantity within a range: plan usage, storage, allowance spent (F-S22, F-H36). Not for progress over time.

props.name: formatOptions
props.doc: e.g. `{ style: "unit", unit: "gigabyte" }`, or a currency.

props.name: valueLabel
props.doc: Optional text instead of the formatted value, e.g. "3 of 5 projects".

props.name: warning
props.doc: Above this share (0–1) the bar turns to warning; above `danger` to danger. Status is also given in words.

items.name: ProgressBar
items.summary: Progress of a task over time (uploads, imports). Omit `value` for indeterminate.

items.name: Skeleton
items.summary: A grey placeholder shaped like the content that is loading.

items.name: Spinner
items.summary: Inline busy indicator for a region that has no better skeleton. Announces its label once.

items.name: StatCard
items.summary: Neutral metric card; colour appears only in the small icon tile.

items.name: Tag
items.summary: Category label; squarer than status badges so the two never read alike.

props.name: color
props.doc: Category colour: trades, rooms, document types. Not for status.

items.name: Tooltip
items.summary: Supplementary hints only; never the sole place for essential information.

items.name: Checkbox
items.summary: A single yes/no choice, or a row's selection checkbox in tables and grids (`slot="selection"`).

props.name: children
props.doc: Optional only for table selection, where React Aria supplies the accessible name.

items.name: ComboBox
items.summary: Type-to-filter picker for long lists: contacts, rates, assemblies, rooms.

props.name: optional
props.doc: Marks the field optional in its label; required is the default expectation.

props.name: labelAside
props.doc: Right side of the label row, e.g. a `<Provenance>` badge for the value.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

items.name: DateField
items.summary: Segmented, locale-aware date entry.

props.name: optional
props.doc: Marks the field optional in its label; required is the default expectation.

props.name: labelAside
props.doc: Right side of the label row, e.g. a `<Provenance>` badge for the value.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

items.name: DatePicker
items.summary: Date entry with a calendar: site visits, validity, milestones.

props.name: optional
props.doc: Marks the field optional in its label; required is the default expectation.

props.name: labelAside
props.doc: Right side of the label row, e.g. a `<Provenance>` badge for the value.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

items.name: NumberField
items.summary: Locale-aware numeric input for quantities, rates, and currency.

props.name: unit
props.doc: Unit shown inside the field, e.g. "m²", "hr", "lot".

props.name: prefix
props.doc: Shown before the value, e.g. "$". Prefer `formatOptions` currency where possible.

props.name: hideStepper
props.doc: Hide −/+ buttons for money and large values.

props.name: variant
props.doc: `inline` for table cells: no edge until hover or focus; empty fields keep their edge as a prompt.

props.name: optional
props.doc: Marks the field optional in its label; required is the default expectation.

props.name: labelAside
props.doc: Right side of the label row, e.g. a `<Provenance>` badge for the value.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

items.name: RadioGroup
items.summary: One choice from a short list; `cards` shows each option as a tile.

props.name: options
props.type: { value: string; label: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; }[]

props.name: variant
props.doc: `cards` renders each option as a selectable tile (pricing basis, base vs upgrade).

props.name: optional
props.doc: Marks the field optional in its label; required is the default expectation.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

props.name: labelAside
props.doc: Right side of the label row, e.g. a `<Provenance>` badge for the value.

items.name: SearchField
items.summary: Text search with a clear button; Esc clears.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

items.name: SegmentedControl
items.summary: Single-choice view switcher (e.g. contractor vs customer view).

props.name: size
props.doc: `sm` matches small fields.

props.name: options
props.type: { id: Key; label: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode; }[]

items.name: Select
items.summary: One choice from a list in a popover. Use ComboBox when people need to type to filter.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Temporary text that occupies the select when it is empty.

props.name: optional
props.doc: Marks the field optional in its label; required is the default expectation.

props.name: labelAside
props.doc: Right side of the label row, e.g. a `<Provenance>` badge for the value.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

items.name: Switch
items.summary: An on/off setting that takes effect immediately.

items.name: TextArea
items.summary: Multi-line text with label, description, and error.

props.name: optional
props.doc: Marks the field optional in its label; required is the default expectation.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

props.name: labelAside
props.doc: Right side of the label row, e.g. a `<Provenance>` badge for the value.

items.name: TextField
items.summary: Single-line text with label, description, error, and optional prefix/suffix.

props.name: prefix
props.doc: Text shown inside the field before the value, e.g. "BP-".

props.name: optional
props.doc: Marks the field optional in its label; required is the default expectation.

props.name: labelAside
props.doc: Right side of the label row, e.g. a `<Provenance>` badge for the value.

props.name: inputRef
props.doc: `inputRef.current.focus()` moves focus into the field (its input, trigger, first date segment, or radio), so error summaries can send people to the problem.

items.name: CardHeader
items.summary: Title row of a card: heading on the start side, actions on the end.

items.name: Card
items.summary: Opaque content surface separated by soft depth, never by an outline.

props.name: variant
props.doc: `default` floats on a soft shadow; `tinted` is a light category panel; `paper` lifts documents.

props.name: color
props.doc: Category colour for the `tinted` variant.

items.name: CategoryColor
items.summary: Decorative ramps for categories (trades, rooms, people). Never for status.

items.name: Container
items.summary: Centres content at a readable maximum width with page gutters.

props.name: width
props.doc: `narrow` 480px (sign-in, single decisions), `text` 720px (reading, forms), `medium` 960px, `wide` 1280px.

items.name: Divider
items.summary: A hairline between groups; prefer space when it's enough.

items.name: Grid
items.summary: Responsive page grids (rail, stats, sidebar, cards, 2, 3). See docs/LAYOUTS.md.

props.name: layout
props.doc: `rail`: main column + 360px side rail. `stats`: 4 across. `2`/`3`: equal columns. `sidebar`: 260px + main. `cards`: as many 280px+ columns as fit (galleries, product and contractor cards). All collapse to one column below 960px (stats go 2 across, then 1).

items.name: Inline
items.summary: Horizontal, wrapping row with a spacing-scale gap.

items.name: SplitView
items.summary: List and detail side by side (inbox, documents, punch list); one pane at a time below 960px. On narrow screens, opening an item moves focus to the detail, and going back returns focus to the list.

props.name: list
props.doc: The list or navigation pane (e.g. a NavList).

props.name: detail
props.doc: The selected item.

props.name: showDetail
props.doc: Below 960px only one pane shows: the detail when something is selected, otherwise the list.

props.name: onBack
props.doc: Below 960px, a back button above the detail calls this (usually clearing the selection).

items.name: Stack
items.summary: Vertical flow with a spacing-scale gap.

items.name: useMediaQuery
items.summary: Whether a media query matches; false during server rendering.

items.name: DateTime
items.summary: A machine-readable date. Accepts a Date or ISO string. Date-only strings ("2026-10-22") are calendar days: they are never shifted by time zone. `short` adds the year when it isn't the current year.

items.name: LocaleProvider
items.summary: Sets the locale, default currency, and text overrides for everything inside. Wrap the app once.

props.name: locale
props.doc: BCP 47 locale for numbers, dates, collation, and component text.

props.name: currency
props.doc: ISO 4217 default currency for `Money` and every amount.

props.name: messages
props.doc: Overrides for built-in component text (any key in `en.json`).

items.name: MessagesProvider
items.summary: Overrides component text for part of the tree (keys from `src/i18n/en.json`).

items.name: useCollator
items.summary: Locale-aware string comparison for sorting (numeric, accent-insensitive).

items.name: useCurrency
items.summary: The default ISO 4217 currency from LocaleProvider.

items.name: useMessages
items.summary: `t("optional")`, `t("removeName", { name })`, `plural("filesAdded", 3)`, and `rich("validUntil", { date: <DateTime …/> })` for sentences with elements inside. Unknown locales fall back to English.

items.name: useMoneyFormat
items.summary: A cached Intl.NumberFormat for money in the current locale and currency.

items.name: useNumberFormat
items.summary: Options are compared by value, so inline objects don't create a new formatter every render.

items.name: Breadcrumbs
items.summary: On narrow screens Breadcrumbs collapse to a back link to the parent.

items.name: NavList
items.summary: A selectable list for the list side of a list-and-detail page (inbox, documents). Arrow keys move; Enter opens.

props.name: emptyState
props.doc: Shown when there are no items.

items.name: Pagination
items.summary: Page through long server-side lists (admin, rate libraries, marketplace results). Shows first, last, and nearby pages.

props.name: page
props.doc: 1-based.

props.name: aria-label
props.doc: Names what is paged, e.g. "Rate library pages".

items.name: SideNav
items.summary: Sidebar navigation in titled sections; marks the current page with `aria-current`.

items.name: Tabs
items.summary: Switch between views of the same thing. Arrow keys move between tabs.

items.name: CloseButton
items.summary: The standard close (×) button used in dialog, drawer, and popover headers.

items.name: ContextualHelp
items.summary: A small "?" that explains a term or rule in place. Reachable by keyboard and touch, unlike `title`.

props.name: title
props.doc: What the help is about; becomes the button's name ("Help: <title>").

items.name: Dialog
items.summary: Deliberate decisions: issuing, sharing, approving, deleting.

props.name: trigger
props.doc: Element that opens the dialog. Omit it to open from a menu, a row action, or code via isOpen/onOpenChange; focus returns to whatever was focused before.

props.name: footer
props.doc: Custom footer actions; receives `close`. Put the confirming action last. Ignored when `onConfirm` is set.

props.name: onConfirm
props.doc: A deliberate action (issue, share, revoke). Return a promise: the dialog stays open and can't be dismissed while it runs, closes when it resolves, and shows the error inside the dialog when it rejects (the thrown message, or a generic one).

props.name: confirmVariant
props.doc: `danger` for destructive actions.

props.name: isConfirmDisabled
props.doc: Disables the confirm button, e.g. until a required field is filled.

props.name: role
props.doc: Alert dialogs cannot be dismissed by clicking outside.

items.name: Menu
items.summary: Actions in a popover menu, opened from any trigger. Use for secondary actions, not navigation.

items.name: Popover
items.summary: Non-modal floating panel for short, interactive content: filters, quick details, help.

props.name: trigger
props.doc: The pressable element that opens it.

props.name: aria-label
props.doc: Accessible name when there is no visible heading.

items.name: useAsyncConfirm
items.summary: Runs an async confirm: keeps the overlay open while pending, closes on success, keeps the error on failure.

items.name: Accordion
items.summary: Groups Disclosures; several can be open at once unless `allowsMultipleExpanded` is false.

items.name: DescriptionList
items.summary: Label/value facts, e.g. a room's measurements or a contact's details.

items.name: Disclosure
items.summary: Collapsible section: scope by room or trade, estimate working, history.

props.name: aside
props.doc: Right side of the header: totals, counts, badges.

props.name: isExpanded
props.doc: Controlled open state.

items.name: Drawer
items.summary: Side sheet for inspecting a record without leaving the page: a line item, a source, a contact.

props.name: trigger
props.doc: Omit to control with isOpen/onOpenChange (e.g. from Table onRowAction).

props.name: width
props.doc: Maximum width in px; always fits the viewport.

items.name: FilterChips
items.summary: Quick filters for lists: document type, room, trade, status.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: Key; label: string; count?: number | undefined; }[]

items.name: Timeline
items.summary: Activity, revision, and decision history (audit trail). Newest first.

items.name: ToastProvider
items.summary: Renders the toast region. Mount once near the root; show toasts with `toast()`.

items.name: toast
items.summary: Shows a toast for 5 s; toasts with an action stay until dismissed (WCAG 2.2.1 timing).

items.name: toasts
items.summary: One queue per app. Toasts confirm completed actions; they never carry decisions or errors that need fixing.

items.name: Table
items.summary: Accessible data table with optional sorting; unknown values sort last.

props.name: onRowAction
props.doc: Enter or click on a row: open a drawer, navigate, etc.

props.name: sortDescriptor
props.doc: Controlled sort; omit for built-in sorting state.

props.name: isLoading
props.doc: Shows skeleton rows and marks the table busy.

props.name: layout
props.doc: `auto` stacks rows as labelled cards below 640px; `table` always keeps columns.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.doc: Keeps the header visible while scrolling long lists (rate libraries).

props.name: dependencies
props.doc: Values the cells render from besides the row itself (view mode, currency…); cells re-render when they change.

items.name: ThemeProvider
items.summary: Applies document-wide theme variables so portalled overlays share their provider's tokens. The innermost mounted provider wins; unmounting restores the outer provider or original document settings.

props.name: neutral
props.doc: `cream` (default) is warm and homey; `grey` is Ant's neutral grey.

items.name: PlumbBrand
items.summary: Denim is the only brand colour.

items.name: useTheme
items.summary: The current ThemeProvider settings.

items.name: Heading
items.summary: Plus Jakarta Sans headings.

props.name: level
props.doc: Visual level.

props.name: as
props.doc: Semantic element; defaults from the visual level.

items.name: Text
items.summary: Inter body text. Use `numeric` for tabular figures.
